translations.web: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
translations.bsb: I am churning within and cannot rest; days of affliction confront me.
translations.kjv: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented
translations.asv: My heart is troubled, and resteth not; Days of affliction are come upon me.
